question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Count customers with LTV > 0
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.amount,
           cfp.first_payment_date,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cfp.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_diff
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as ltv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_diff <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_diff <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as num_customers,
       AVG(1.0 * ltv_7days / ltv * 100) as avg_pct_7days,
       AVG(1.0 * ltv_30days / ltv * 100) as avg_pct_30days,
       AVG(ltv) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_ltv
WHERE ltv > 0

{"sql": "-- Verify with a few customers
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.amount,
           cfp.first_payment_date,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cfp.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_diff
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as ltv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_diff <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_diff <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, ltv, ltv_7days, ltv_30days,
       ROUND(1.0 * ltv_7days / ltv * 100, 2) as pct_7days,
       ROUND(1.0 * ltv_30days / ltv * 100, 2) as pct_30days
FROM customer_ltv
WHERE ltv > 0
ORDER BY customer_id
LIMIT 10", "preview_rows": 12}
